conditions.details: Must be part of the physician's course of treatment and be prescribed to effect improvement, or arrest or retard deterioration in the patient's condition.

conditions.note: The fact that a patient has difficulty or is even incapable of getting up from a chair, particularly a low chair, is not sufficient justification.

value: can be controlled by the patient
effectively assists standing up and sitting down without other assistance
treating physician for the disease or condition
consulting physician for the disease or condition

conditions.details: Physician's record must document that all appropriate therapeutic modalities (e.g., medication, physical therapy) to enable the patient to transfer from a chair to a standing position have been tried and failed.

exclusions.description: Type of lift which operates by a spring release mechanism with a sudden, catapult-like motion and jolts the patient from a seated to a standing position.
Seat lift mechanisms for wheelchairs (refer to Mobility Assistive Devices criteria).

limitations.description: Coverage is limited to the seat lift mechanism, even if it is incorporated into a chair (E0627).
Payment for a seat lift mechanism incorporated into a chair (E0627) is based on the allowance for the least costly alternative (E0628, E0629).

documentation_requirements.description: Last 6 months of clinical notes from requesting provider &/or specialist including details outlined in criteria.
